# SCALE

> S-PLUS Clusters and Large-scale Environments

This file helps language models discover the most useful content on this site.

## Home

- [About the project](https://splus-scale.github.io/home.md): SCALE studies galaxy clusters, groups and their large-scale environments with the 12-band photometry of S-PLUS.

## About

- [About](https://splus-scale.github.io/about.md): The Southern Photometric Local Universe Survey, and the SCALE project built on it.

## Areas

- [areas](https://splus-scale.github.io/areas.md): S-PLUS Clusters and Large-scale Environments

## Publications

- [Publications](https://splus-scale.github.io/publications.md): S-PLUS Clusters and Large-scale Environments
- [SCALE: Using S-PLUS photometric information to analyse the brightest cluster galaxy alignment with satellite galaxies](https://splus-scale.github.io/publications/2025/doubrawa.md): Astronomy & Astrophysics (2025)
- [S-PLUS Clusters And Large-scale Environments (SCALE): II. PZWav versus redMaPPer identification of eRosita groups](https://splus-scale.github.io/publications/2026/doubrawa.md): Astronomy & Astrophysics (2026)
- [S-PLUS Clusters And Large-scale Environments (SCALE): I. A catalog of known systems in DR5 and a pilot study of Abell 4038](https://splus-scale.github.io/publications/2026/mendes-de-oliveira.md): The Astrophysical Journal (2026)
- [https://splus-scale.github.io/publications/](https://splus-scale.github.io/publications/page/1.md)

## Publishers

- [Publisher](https://splus-scale.github.io/publishers.md): S-PLUS Clusters and Large-scale Environments
- [Asociación Argentina de Astronomía](https://splus-scale.github.io/publishers/aaa.md): Non-profit scientific association dedicated to advancing astronomy and related sciences in Argentina.
- [American Astronomical Society](https://splus-scale.github.io/publishers/aas.md): Professional society of astronomers and astrophysicists in North America, advancing scientific understanding of the universe.
- [Brazilian Center for Research in Physics](https://splus-scale.github.io/publishers/cbpf.md): Research institute of the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MCTI) dedicated to physics research and graduate training in Brazil.
- [EDP Sciences](https://splus-scale.github.io/publishers/edp.md): International academic publisher dedicated to scientific, technical and medical research, founded in 1920 by French learned societies.
- [Elsevier](https://splus-scale.github.io/publishers/elsevier.md): Global leader in information and analytics, specializing in scientific, technical and medical publishing.
- [European Southern Observatory](https://splus-scale.github.io/publishers/eso.md): Intergovernmental astronomy organisation operating ground-based observatories in the Atacama Desert.
- [Institute of Physics Publishing](https://splus-scale.github.io/publishers/iop.md): Society-owned scientific publisher producing peer-reviewed journals, books, and conference proceedings in physics and related disciplines.
- [Oxford University Press](https://splus-scale.github.io/publishers/oup.md): Department of the University of Oxford furthering excellence in research, scholarship, and education through academic publishing.
- [Royal Astronomical Society](https://splus-scale.github.io/publishers/ras.md): Learned society encouraging and promoting the study of astronomy, solar-system science, geophysics and closely related disciplines.
